run_franka_navigation: run the Franka robot pointnav navigation example with random actions in the Habitat environment
run_franka_no_render: run the Franka robot navigation example without rendering RGB observations using the --no-render flag
create_habitat_env: create a Habitat environment using habitat.Env with a pointnav_franka config YAML file
load_habitat_config: load a Habitat benchmark config using habitat.get_config with a YAML path string
step_environment: step the Habitat environment with a sampled action and collect RGB observations each step
